props.name: allowComments
props.comment: Tolerate comments and trailing commas in the text.

props.name: alwaysOn
props.comment:
As a `<FilterForm>`/`<FilterButton>` filter: always shown, never in the
add-filter menu. Read off the element by the filter layer, never by the input.

props.name: autoHeight
props.comment: Grow with the content between `minHeight` and `maxHeight`. Defaults to false.

props.name: className
props.comment: Class for the field wrapper.

props.name: defaultValue
props.comment: Input-level default, ra precedence (seeds only into an untouched hole).

props.name: disabled
props.comment: Native disabled state.

props.name: editorClassName
props.comment: Class for the editor frame.

props.name: format
props.comment: Read transform (raw form value → input value).

props.name: height
props.comment: Editor height in pixels when `autoHeight` is false. Defaults to 300.

props.name: helperText
props.comment: Helper text rendered below the input; a string is translated.

props.name: id
props.comment: Explicit element id; a generated `useId` value is used otherwise.

props.name: isRequired
props.comment: Forces the required marker; ORed with `required()` detection on `validate`.

props.name: label
props.comment:
The input label. A string is translated; a ReactNode renders as-is;
`false` (or `""`) renders no label.

props.name: maxHeight
props.comment: Tallest the editor grows to when `autoHeight` is on. Defaults to 600.

props.name: minHeight
props.comment: Shortest the editor gets when `autoHeight` is on. Defaults to 120.

props.name: monacoOptions
props.comment: Merged over the editor defaults, so it can override any of them.

props.name: name
props.comment: Legacy field-name alias (ra parity); the wiring uses `source`.

props.name: onBlur
props.comment: Chained AFTER the blur is recorded.

props.name: onChange
props.comment: Chained AFTER the parsed value is written to the form.

props.name: parse
props.comment: Write transform (input value → stored value).

props.name: readOnly
props.comment: Native read-only state.

props.name: resource
props.comment: Override the ambient resource (used to resolve the default label key).

props.name: schema
props.comment: A JSON Schema the value is checked against. Object shape only.

props.name: schemaUri
props.comment: A schema Monaco fetches from this URL. Ignored when `schema` is set.

props.name: showFormatButton
props.comment: Show the Format button. Defaults to true.

props.name: source
props.comment: The field path RELATIVE to the ambient source scope.

props.name: type
props.comment: The DOM input `type` (text inputs default to `"text"`).

props.name: validate
props.comment: ra-contract validators — composed, first error wins.
